rec.name: Compare Section (Static Product Comparison Table)
rec.status: Built — launched (documented; a later comment says another ticket has near-identical acceptance criteria, so it may be a duplicate)

what.text: A Shopify section that shows 2–4 shop-owner-selected products side by side in a comparison table. Each product column has an image, title, price (optional), color swatches, and a 'Zum Produkt' (view product) button. Below the products, a table has editor-defined row labels (e.g. Dimensions, Price, Wood type) with a comparison value per product. Values come from product metafields or are typed in manually. Headline and sub-headline are optional blocks above the table, and the table can be collapsed behind an 'Alles einblenden' (show all) toggle. The shopper cannot choose products to compare; the merchant curates them.

why.text: Side-by-side comparison lowers choice overload and cognitive effort. Shoppers can see the differences in specs and price at a glance, which reduces the need to open several tabs or leave the page. A clear 'view product' CTA on each column sends the undecided shopper to the best-fit item. The table also works as cross-sell and upsell, since it puts higher-priced alternatives next to the current product.

how.text: Add the section file ed-cro-compare-section.liquid. Section-level settings cover background color, text color and spacing for desktop and mobile, an optional max width, table background color and table corner radius. Content is built from blocks: heading, subheading, content (rich text), button, and 'item' blocks, one per product. The number of products equals the number of item blocks (2–4). In each item block the merchant picks a shop product and toggles the price. Row names are entered as rich text that supports bold, italic and underline. For each row, the comparison value is either read from a product metafield or entered manually per product, and both modes are supported. Typography is controlled through CSS custom properties set per block (font family, size, line-height, letter-spacing, alignment, text transform, spacing). Separate mobile values are available. Button colors can be customized. The mobile layout keeps the 2-column table with a collapse toggle.

items: Section background color
Section text/font color
Table background color and corner radius
Section padding top/bottom/left/right, separate for desktop and mobile
Optional custom max width
Heading block: rich text (bold/italic/underline), custom font, size, line-height, letter-spacing, alignment, transform, spacing, max width; separate mobile values
Subheading block: same typography controls, with mobile overrides
Content block: rich text with typography controls
Button block: text color, background color, text transform
Product item blocks: 2, 3 or 4 products selected from the shop
Show/hide price per product
'Zum Produkt' button color
Row names with rich text formatting
Comparison values: product metafield or manual entry per product

dependencies.text: Theme assumed to be the Impact theme: the code uses its global settings (settings.heading_color, settings.background) and its .button--primary and .button--secondary classes. Needs product metafields if the metafield mode is used; the ticket marks metafields as required (MF/J). Product swatches, the compare-at price and the 'Alles einblenden' toggle are visible in the screenshots, but their implementation is not confirmed in the truncated code. No app is needed for the static version. A buyer-selected comparison (option 1) was split into a separate ticket and would likely need an app.

items: Click-through rate on the 'Zum Produkt' buttons
Conversion rate of sessions that see the section vs. those that don't
Average order value / share of higher-priced variants chosen
Scroll depth to and engagement with the section
Clicks on 'Alles einblenden' (show all)
Bounce and exit rate on the page

images.caption: Desktop (Holz4Home reference): a 3-column grid with an empty label column on the left, then two products. Each product has an image, title, red sale price with struck-through original price, color swatches and a 'Zum Produkt' button. Row labels (Maße, Preis, Holzart) are in bold and values sit in their own columns. An 'Alles einblenden' toggle sits at the bottom.
Mobile (Holz4Home reference): a compact 2-product layout with image, title, price and swatches. Rows for Maße, Preis and Holzart are stacked, with an 'Alles einblenden' toggle at the bottom.
Design inspiration (Sectionfy-style): a rounded table card with 3 products, view buttons and spec rows (Driver, Weight, Dimensions, Battery).
Design inspiration: the compare table placed next to a headline with an underlined highlight word, sub-text and a 'Learn more' button, showing the heading/subheading/button blocks.
